direction: Evolve the generalized Clarke-Wright static merge score in a global depot-scale-normalized space: score(i,j) = (d0i + d0j - lam*dij + mu*|d0i - d0j|)/mean(d0,1..n) + beta*clip((qi+qj)/Q,0,1) with lam ~1.00-1.15, mu ~0.08-0.15, beta ~0.05-0.15, plus an optional endpoint demand-balance term (1 - |qi-qj|/(qi+qj)) and a gentle superlinear fill reward clip(((qi+qj)/Q)^2,0,1) to suppress fragmented tail routes; keep the hook a single fully vectorized pass over the upper-triangle positive-savings candidate list so it stays well inside the 25 ms budget at n up to 200.

operations.mechanism: KB entry method-cvrp-m2-l2a-generalized-savings provides a verified, five-gate-passed L2a scoring family (dev_24 16.1398 at zero postprocess, scale-invariant at 1e-3, p50 hook < 0.4 ms, 100% completion under both 500 ms and 25 ms budgets) plus an explicit invariants list (global mean depot-distance normalization, one-shot vectorized scoring, positive-savings candidate filtering) and a documented pitfall (per-pair normalization regresses dev_24 to ~18.0). The archive is empty, so round 1 should anchor on this verified regime and let EoH explore lam/mu/beta plus fill-shape variants around it. postprocess_mode is kept at 'none' to isolate construction-layer gains and avoid local-search cost pushing n=200 instances past the 25 ms cutoff, consistent with the KB's noted weak point (no post-merge relocate) that later portfolio rounds can complement with a relocate_2opt variant.

preserve: Route feasibility, strict time budget, and scale invariance.
hypothesis: Under a strict 25 ms budget on cvrp_dev_hetero_24, a globally depot-scale-normalized generalized savings score with mild edge-length penalty (lam 1.0-1.15), radial asymmetry correction (mu 0.08-0.15) and a dimensionless capacity-fill / endpoint-balance bonus will beat plain Clarke-Wright savings (dev_24 ~16.22) and approach or improve the M2 verified L2a level (16.14) with zero timeout degradation, because per-pair local normalization destroys far-cluster merge priority (degrading to ~18.0) while global scaling preserves it.
